blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Carlos Yulo is putting the focus on his performance as he chases the Philippines’ first gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games in Thursday’s men’s gymnastics floor exercise final. The two-time Olympic champion said he wants to use the final to showcase the artistry and elegance of his gymnastics while staying composed under pressure.
